footprint.ev: 0x0044B050: size 1 -> SPR_FOOT_PRINT1[0] (houses SPR_FOOT_PRINT2[0]); size n -> SPR_FOOT_PRINT1_NW + off (houses SPR_FOOT_PRINT2_NW), off -1 = SPR_FOOT_PRINT1[1] (interior); tiles [i, j, off] from the min corner
footprint.rule: general w x h (checked against every table): (0,0) 0 top, (w-1,0) 2, (w-1,h-1) 4, (0,h-1) 6, edges j=0 1, i=w-1 3, j=h-1 5, i=0 7, inside -1

column.ev: 0x0055EC00(n, x, y, style): n clamped to 10; colour c = 12 for style 2, 0 for style 0, style 1: n>=9 9, >=7 6, >=5 3 else 0; base (c+2) at (x+9, y-8); n>=1: top (c) at (x+5, y-10n-top_h+15) and n-1 middles (c+1) at (x+17, y-5-10k); x, y = top-left of the anchor tile (the left tile (x, y+h-1)), raised

supplies.ev: 0x0055F5A0: background at (x+11, y-16): SPR_OVERLAY_SLOT3 (common, 3 slots) / SPR_OVERLAY_SLOT6 (elite); slot i at (x+21+26i, y-6) when the house needs it now or at the next level (house_param 0x00433D80); icon SPR_SUPPLY_OK, or when stock <= low[level][i] (0x0055F440) blinking SPR_SUPPLY_LOW_ON/OFF every 512 ms; icon index by good (0x0055F3E0): fleece 0, armor 1, food 2, oil 3, wine 4, horses 5

problems.ev: 0x00565030: background at (x, y), icons from (x+k, y+k) (k 2 houses, 10 others), 26 px per slot; icon = SPR_PROBLEM_ICONS[bit]; bits from building_status_flags 0x00564560

bits.0: house devolving (0x00484660 returns -1: below its own level)

security_elite.ev: 0x00563240 (See security, per elite house on its image-2 quadrant): image 0 pad (iso 4) at (x+0x1E, y-0x4B), then rows of 1 spare armour, 2 unarmed, 5 spare horses, 4 chariots, 3 hoplites (packed 0xACA + 3); counts 0x00563180; viewer/play/overlays.js securityPad

hygiene_food.ev: 0x00560680: drawn at (x+20, y) when the house ate (b+0x7F)

appeal.ev: 0x0044B830: buildable or built tiles (flags & 0x15361667 == 0, or 0x8) with desirability != 0 or a building/garden: SPR_DES_HOUSE (house tiles) / SPR_DES_NOHOUSE [d <= -11: 0, d < 70: d/10 + 2 (C division), else 9]; wall tiles SPR_IN_FILL1[rand & 7]; other tiles keep their image; buildings not in the list are flattened

minimap.ev: minimap_draw 0x00454980: with an overlay on (0x00FA05F0 != 0) a building's draw tile (draw byte 0x40) gets the image from the view object's +0x24 (0x0055F250, all overlays) instead of its per-type group; burning tint off. 0x0055F250: avenue 118 / boulevard 126 / agoras 63, 64 -> SPR_R_ROAD; else +0x28 true -> red (SPR_R_FIRST_BUILD+10); else +0x30 -> green (+5); else +0x2C -> purple (+20); else black (+60, the same image the normal minimap uses for walls). The piece size picks image + n as for normal buildings (ui.json minimap.buildings.rule; for the road colour image + n runs into the next groups, sic).

appeal.ev: overlay 17 only, before figures and buildings: tile flags & 8 or desirability != 0 -> k = 0x0044BCF0 (d <= -11: 0, d < 70: d/10 + 2 (C division), else 9; the main view's SPR_DES_* index), image SPR_R_LAVA + 8 + 5k (palette.appeal[k]); other tiles: normal terrain

minimap.figures: 0x00454920: a tile's figures give a dot only if the overlay's walker test (+0x10, modes[id].walkers) holds for one of them (or figure type 6 with b+0x16C in 1..9); the normal map's extra types 22/23/27/29 are dotted only with no overlay. Dot colours unchanged (ui.json minimap.figures).
minimap.terrain: unchanged by overlays (except appeal); walls stay SPR_R_FIRST_BUILD+60

tooltip.ev: game_turn calls 0x004F6A10 every frame (no delay): needs mouse help on (0x00F2A7B4 != 0, Options; default 2), no UI widget under the mouse (0x00781834 <= 0), right button up, city screen, not the editor, a map tile under the mouse (0x00DA2F6C = tile from the mouse, 0x0044A270: the ground diamond, not the sprite) and an overlay on; then +0x1C(tile, buf 0x00EF7F70) builds the text; true -> drawn by tooltip_draw 0x004F6E40 this frame
tooltip.box: width w = 220; text_layout width 190 (font 9DKBU, 0x00EF8C9C); if more than 2 lines: w = 300, width 270. h = lines*16 + 10. x = mouse_x + 20 if mouse_x < w + 20 else mouse_x - w - 20 (normally LEFT of the mouse); y = mouse_y + 50, or mouse_y - 72 when mouse_y >= 200. Outline rect (x, y, w+20, h) colour 0x0084 (555) / 0x0104 (565) = rgb(0,33,33); fill (x+1, y+1, w+18, h-2) 0x09B2 (555) / 0x1372 (565) = rgb(16,107,148); text at (x+5, y+7), width w-30. '@L' ends a line.
tooltip.token: {group:index} = extracted/text/zeus_text.json group/index; a leading number is the value printed by number_to_text 0x00508540
